note: Adapted from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera); the original is in English. The original records only the soldier (S, Pw). OCR problem: in 'length of head to base of mandibles 3.2-3..3' the reading '3..3' is a corruption of '3.3', and the measurement is treated as 3.2—3.3.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and mandibles reddish brown; antennae brown at the base, paler apically; mandibles black, reddish brown at the base; labrum pale brown; pronotum, legs and body yellowish white; head and body sparsely hairy. Total body length about 10.7 mm. Head capsule rectangular, about one and a half times as long as wide; head length (to the base of the mandibles) 3.2—3.3, head width 2.10—2.2 mm; sides almost parallel, frons sloping forwards, its median concavity reaching the middle or slightly beyond; Y-shaped suture not visible. Eyes white, flat, suboval (maximum diameter 0.10—0.15, minimum diameter 0.05—0.075 mm); the shortest eye–antenna distance is 1.5 times the maximum diameter of the eye. Ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 longer than or equal to segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus flat, rectangular, darker than the frons, anterior margin with 2 pairs of long hairs; anteclypeus narrow, white, trapezoidal. Labrum subsquare (width 0.50—0.55, length 0.30—0.40 mm), with a few short and long hairs at the apex and on the disc. Mandibles long and stout, 1.70—1.80 mm long; nearly straight, with a weak swelling on the outer side of the base, the apex slightly incurved; slightly more than half the head length (to the base of the mandibles) (mandible length/head length index 0.53—0.55); left mandible with 5 distinct marginal teeth, right mandible with 2 large, almost equal marginal teeth. Postmentum long, clavate; the bulb subsquare, its anterior and posterior halves almost equal and indistinctly bilobed, narrowing posteriorly into a long waist; length 2.60—2.80, maximum width of the bulb 0.75—0.80, minimum width of the waist 0.30—0.35 mm. Pronotum subrectangular (width 2.10, length 0.90—1.10 mm), about as wide as the head; sparsely hairy; anterior margin shallowly concave, without a median notch; posterior margin straight, slightly incurved in the middle. Legs slender; tibial spurs 3:3:3; tarsus 4-segmented. Abdomen long, each tergite with one row of sparse hairs; cerci short, hairy, 2-segmented.
